propositions: The original claim that link-audit --repair fails due to ModuleNotFoundError on rebar_reconciler import was disproven; the import succeeds because sys.path is populated with engine_dir() before the import statement.

The reconciler in-flight probe check_pass_lock correctly honors lease expiry and returns False once the 120-second lease expires, as demonstrated by runtime sampling showing a frozen heartbeat and discriminating H1/H2 experiment.
Every refusal of link-audit --repair coincided with a genuinely live reconciler lease; the guard behaves as designed and requires waiting out the in-flight pass rather than indicating a defect.
The fsck --repair command shares the same correct _reconciler_in_flight function and is not affected by the withdrawn claim.
_reconciler_in_flight has no test coverage but this is a coverage gap, not a defect.
